roles.name: gp-architect
roles.description: Use before implementing a change to supabase/migrations, RLS policies, grants, SECURITY DEFINER functions or goproceed_* roles, a /v1 or /external contract (packages/contracts, technical/openapi, technical/error-catalog.csv), a state, transition, capability or event catalog, an outbox or worker, retention or erasure, or the Telegram channel workflow: return a minimal design, affected invariants, failure cases and whether an ADR is required, without editing.

roles.name: gp-implementer
roles.description: Use only when the coordinator explicitly delegates a bounded GoProceed slice with allowed paths; the primary session normally implements. Delivers a scoped diff and the relevant checks.
roles.claude_tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Edit, Write

roles.name: gp-reviewer
roles.description: Use proactively after any GoProceed behavior change, before reporting done, committing or merging: review the supplied diff file for correctness, tenant isolation, migration and contract compatibility, catalog drift and regressions without editing.

roles.name: gp-security
roles.description: Use proactively after a GoProceed change touching RLS, grants, SECURITY DEFINER or database roles, Supabase Auth, sessions, proxy or auth email templates, external capability links or HMAC keys, evidence storage, signed URLs or uploads, the Telegram webhook, bot tokens or identity erasure, apps/landing /api/pilot, application environment variables (.env*, NEXT_PUBLIC_*, hosted secrets) or secrets, CI permissions or action pins, or retention and deletion of personal data: review the supplied diff for trust-boundary risks.

roles.name: gp-qa
roles.description: Use proactively on the final revision of any GoProceed behavior change, after review findings are resolved and before reporting done: verify each acceptance criterion against actual evidence and report PASS / FAIL / NOT RUN per criterion; a skipped suite is NOT RUN.

roles.name: gp-researcher
roles.description: Use when a GoProceed decision depends on an unverified fact about an installed library or hosted service (Next.js 16, Expo SDK 57, Supabase, supabase-js, Telegram Bot API, Vercel, Resend) or a Ukrainian regulatory source: answer from the installed version's docs and primary sources with dates and explicit uncertainty.

roles.name: gp-ui-reviewer
roles.description: Use proactively after a GoProceed change under apps/landing, apps/app/app, apps/app/src/components, apps/mobile/src, packages/ui, packages/tokens or technical/copy-catalog.csv: review the diff, the pasted UI gate output and the harness screenshots against docs/design/02-building-ui.md, DESIGN.md and the role-pain map, and return PASS or HOLD.

roles.name: gp-mobile
roles.description: Use before designing or reviewing a GoProceed change involving the PWA field client's installability, offline or capture behaviour, apps/mobile (Expo SDK 57, app.json), signing, store or OTA distribution, or physical-device behaviour: return requirements and acceptance cases.
